tools.name: check
tools.description: Checks the leaf-lang program text in source. The text is the langc check --json lines.

tools.name: fmt
tools.description: Gives the canonical text of the leaf-lang program text in source, or the diagnostic as one JSON line.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Gives the langc explain --json lines of the leaf-lang program text in source. name selects one declaration.

tools.name: list-base
tools.description: Gives the names of the base signature (PLAN sec 3), one on each line.

tools.name: show-law
tools.description: Gives the law id (L1 to L7, PLAN sec 6) as one JSON line: the text, the slice and the check.
